title: 第3章 房子太小了
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
不得不说，郁嘉庆的猜测是正确的。

    从郁嘉庆和盛素华口中得知孩子们在上班和上学，吃晚饭时才会回家，看了看这个挤着一家五口人的公寓，觉得有必要去换个房子了。

    和郁嘉庆和盛素华打了声招呼，拒绝了郁嘉庆的陪同，便走出了家门。

    郁凡虽然目前并没有钱，可他之前便探查过他的储物空间还在，还好他曾经去异世界的人界游历过，空间内也收了不少自己喜欢的东西。

    选出一块最不值钱的玉，郁凡决定找家当铺给典当了。

    用神识扫描了一圈周围的环境，总算是找到一家小当铺。

    原本想要瞬移过去，却突然意识到自己如今只有筑基期的修为，没有了空间穿梭能力。

    无奈的郁凡只能快速的移动到当铺。

    这一幕正好被一路人看到，“我去，这人跑得可真快！”

    郁凡走进当铺，想来这当铺生意不太好，店里只有一个店员在闲着拍苍蝇，看到人进来，倒是很热情。

    “先生，你好，请问您是想要典当些什么？”

    郁凡拿出手中的玉，“我要当了这个，你看看，值多少钱？”

    店员虽然年轻但还是有点眼力见的，这年轻人虽然穿着怪异，但那浑身的气势就不似一般人，连忙双手接过手中的玉。

    这一看，便觉得手中这玉可能不简单，便对郁凡客气的说道：“您先坐下喝口茶，我这边需要师傅检验玉的品质。”

    将郁凡引到座位上，端上招待贵宾的茶后，店员便回后到前台后被帘子遮掩的房间内。

    房间里有个老师傅正在打着瞌睡。

    “梁师傅，您给掌掌眼，这玉似乎是个好东西。”店员小王尊敬的对老师傅说道。

    梁师傅有些不耐的睁开眼睛，“这小地方能有什么好东西？”

    若不是为了方便自己养老，他又怎么会屈居在这五环外的小分店里。

    然而接过小王手中的玉，仅仅只是一个触碰间就明白这玉确实不凡。

    入手温润的触感，颜色浓翠鲜艳夺目，色正不邪色阳悦目，色均匀和看后赏目。

    “这，这是老坑玻璃种啊！”梁师傅激动的惊叹道！
content_en:
It has to be said that Yu Jiaqing's guess is correct.

They learned from Yu Jiaqing and Sheng Suhua that the children were at work and school and would go home only after dinner. After looking at this apartment crowded with a family of five, they felt it was necessary to change their house.

He greeted Yu Jiaqing and Sheng Suhua, refused Yu Jiaqing's company, and walked out of the house.

Although Yu Fan currently has no money, he had previously checked that his storage space was still there. Fortunately, he had traveled to the human world in another world and had collected many of his favorite things in the space.

After selecting the least valuable piece of jade, Yu Fan decided to find a pawn shop to pawn it.

I used my spiritual consciousness to scan the surrounding environment and finally found a small pawn shop.

I originally wanted to teleport over, but suddenly realized that I only had the cultivation level of the Foundation Establishment Stage and no longer had the ability to travel through space.

Helpless, Yu Fan could only move quickly to the pawn shop.

This scene happened to be seen by a passerby, "I'll go, this man runs so fast!"

Yu Fan walked into the pawn shop. He thought that the business of this pawn shop was not very good. There was only one clerk in the shop who was busy swatting flies. He was very enthusiastic when he saw people coming in.

"Hello, sir, what do you want to pawn?"

Yu Fan took out the jade in his hand, "I'm going to pawn this. Look, how much is it worth?"

Although the clerk was young, he still had some discernment. Although the young man was dressed strangely, his aura was different from that of ordinary people. He quickly took the jade in his hand with both hands.

At this glance, he felt that the jade in his hand might not be simple, so he said politely to Yu Fan: "Sit down and have a sip of tea first. I need a master to test the quality of the jade."

After guiding Yu Fan to his seat and serving the tea for the distinguished guests, the clerk went back to the room covered by the curtain behind the front desk.

There was an old master dozing off in the room.

"Master Liang, please tell me, this jade seems to be a good thing." The clerk Xiao Wang said to the master respectfully.

Master Liang opened his eyes impatiently, "What good things can be found in this small place?"

If it weren't for the convenience of his own retirement, how could he settle in this small branch outside the Fifth Ring Road.

However, after taking the jade in Xiao Wang's hand, he understood that this jade was indeed extraordinary just by touching it.

It has a warm touch, the color is rich and emerald, the color is bright and dazzling, the color is righteous and not evil, the color is yang and pleasing to the eye, the color is uniform and pleasing to the eye after looking at it.

"This, this is Laokeng glass!" Master Liang exclaimed excitedly!
title_en: Chapter 3 The house is too small
